looks.caption: Step 2 film 11.70 to 12.10 s: the last reel stops, the housing kicks, the first coin leaves the mouth, the coins reach the arrow
Step 2 film: top, the handle meets the arrow and kicks it away at 16.78 to 17.05 s; bottom, the arrow after the coins at 12.80 to 13.45 s
Step 2 film 5.50 to 6.00 s: the dial whips the arrow round, arrests it sharp at 5.58 to 5.62 s, flings it and springs home
Step 2 film 16.80 to 19.60 s: the blow, the flat arrow turning and shrinking back at the warning, the approach to Continue in two parts
